author: notes-about
title: Ardshinbank at a glance
body: Ardshinbank is a universal bank in Armenia offering retail and commercial banking, investment banking, and private and wealth solutions. It serves individuals, small and medium-sized businesses and large corporate customers. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Ardshinbank's history
body: The bank was founded in 2002 as Ardshininvestbank and received banking licence no. 83 in February 2003. In 2003 it took over a large part of the assets, liabilities and infrastructure of Ardshinbank OJSC and Armagrobank, and in November 2014 it was rebranded as Ardshinbank CJSC. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Mergers and acquisitions
body: Areximbank-Gazprombank Group was merged into Ardshinbank on 13 January 2017. On 29 November 2024 Ardshinbank completed the acquisition of 100% of HSBC Bank Armenia. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Branch network and customers
body: According to the bank, Ardshinbank serves more than 900,000 customers with over 2,400 employees and 73 branches, the largest branch network in Armenia, including branches in Yerevan, Gyumri, Vanadzor, Goris and Hrazdan. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Market position
body: Ardshinbank reports being the largest bank in Armenia by total assets, with roughly a fifth of the market, and among the largest by loan portfolio. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Strategic priorities
body: The bank names as priority areas project financing for large corporate customers, especially in strategic industries and the energy sector, lending to small and medium-sized businesses, issuing and servicing payment cards, e-banking, international money transfers and mortgage lending. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-about
title: Social and environmental risks in lending
body: Ardshinbank publishes how social and environmental risks are part of its credit risk management system: projects are assessed for environmental and social impact as part of underwriting. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/en/content/social-and-environmental-risks-credit-risk-management-system

author: notes-about
title: General terms of banking services
body: The bank's general terms of banking services describe how accounts, cards, deposits and transfers work and are the reference for the relationship between the bank and its customers. They are published as a document on the website. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/api/files/documents/general-terms-eng--b9e824dc-063c-45b1-8f67-6b68b6aa4d99.pdf

author: notes-cards
title: Ardshinbank debit cards
body: Debit card options include Mastercard Debit, Visa Classic and ArCa, and their Instant versions (Mastercard Debit Instant, Visa Classic Instant, ArCa Instant) that can be issued on the spot. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/cards-debit?lang=en

author: notes-cards
title: Ardshinbank credit cards
body: Credit cards range from Mastercard Standard Flexi and Mastercard Standard to Mastercard Gold, Mastercard Platinum and Mastercard World Black Edition, plus an ArCa Classic credit card. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/credit-cards?lang=en

author: notes-cards
title: Premium cards
body: Higher-tier cards include Mastercard Gold, Visa Gold, Visa Platinum and Visa Infinite, typically with higher limits and travel and lifestyle benefits. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/en/content/visa-platinum

author: notes-cards
title: ArCa, the Armenian card system
body: ArCa is Armenia's national card payment system. Ardshinbank issues ArCa debit and credit cards alongside international Visa and Mastercard cards. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/cards-debit?lang=en

author: notes-cards
title: Cards for non-residents
body: Non-residents of Armenia can get an ArCa card or a Visa Classic card, the latter available in several currencies such as AMD, USD, EUR and CNY; a Visa Signature card for non-residents is also offered. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/cards/visa-classic-non-residnet?lang=en

author: notes-cards
title: Google Pay and Apple Pay
body: Ardshinbank's Visa and Mastercard cards can be added to Google Pay, and Ardshinbank was among the first Armenian banks whose cards work with Apple Pay. Wallet payments use a token instead of the card number. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://googlepay.ardshinbank.am/en

author: notes-cards
title: Cards issued under the Ardshininvestbank name
body: Cards issued earlier under the bank's former name, Ardshininvestbank, are described on a separate page of the website. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/cards-issued-by-ardshininvestbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Consumer loans
body: Ardshinbank offers unsecured consumer loans in Armenian drams over multi-year terms. The website lists the current range of amounts, terms and rates and states that customers receiving their salary or pension on an Ardshinbank card get reduced rates. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Loans against funds held at the bank
body: Customers can borrow against money they keep at the bank, up to the full amount available, which is a secured form of consumer credit. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Refinancing loans from other institutions
body: The bank offers to refinance loans taken from other financial institutions and move them to Ardshinbank under its own conditions. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Consumer mortgage loans
body: Mortgage loans finance the purchase of a home with fixed or floating rates over terms of several years to fifteen years. Floating rates are expressed as a reference rate plus a margin; current figures are published on the site. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Mortgages for public servants
body: Under Armenia's affordable housing programme for public servants, Ardshinbank offers mortgage loans with preferential fixed or floating rates that depend on the loan amount. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/vark-hanrayin-carayoxnerin?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Mortgages for servicemen
body: Exclusive mortgage loan programmes are offered to military servicemen, alongside programmes for specific housing developments. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-loans
title: Mortgage terms for specific housing projects
body: For some residential projects the bank publishes dedicated real estate acquisition mortgage terms, such as the Nor Nork and Acharyan programmes. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/en/content/nor-nork

author: notes-loans
title: Effective interest rate in Armenian disclosures
body: Armenian banks publish both the nominal rate and the effective (actual) annual rate of a loan; the effective rate includes fees and is the figure to compare. Ardshinbank's loan pages show both. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/loans-ardshinbank?lang=en

author: notes-savings
title: Term deposits
body: Term deposits are offered in AMD, USD, EUR and RUB for periods from about one month to several months and longer, with interest paid at the end of the term or monthly or quarterly. A bank account is needed to open one. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/avand?lang=en

author: notes-savings
title: Nominal rate and annual yield
body: Deposit pages show the nominal interest rate and the annual percentage yield, which is what you would earn if the interest were reinvested. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/avand?lang=en

author: notes-savings
title: Savings accounts
body: Ardshinbank's savings account pays interest on drams held in the account, with flexible access. Opening it, withdrawing cash and intra-bank transfers are free of charge. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/avand?lang=en

author: notes-savings
title: Deposits for non-residents
body: Non-resident individuals can open standard term deposits, and the bank offers tariff packages for non-resident individuals covering accounts, cards, deposits and transfers. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://old.ardshinbank.am/en/content/standard-deposits-non-residents

author: notes-savings
title: Business deposits
body: Legal entities and private entrepreneurs, resident or not, can place standard term deposits. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-your-business/deposit?lang=en

author: notes-savings
title: Safe deposit boxes
body: Safe deposit boxes in vaults with a modern security system can be rented in several sizes for terms from one day to one year; non-residents pay a higher tariff. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-you/safe-boxes?lang=en

author: notes-digital
title: Ardshinbank mobile app
body: The mobile app lets customers check balances, transfer money, pay bills and apply for loans. It is available in Armenian, English and Russian on the App Store and Google Play. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://apps.apple.com/am/app/ardshinbank/id1237344603

author: notes-digital
title: Transfers by phone number or card
body: In the app, money can be sent between Ardshinbank accounts using the recipient's mobile number or by scanning a card, and to cards and accounts at other banks. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=am.lsoft.mobilebanking.ashb

author: notes-digital
title: International transfers through UBPay
body: Ardshinbank joined the UBPay money transfer system, which supports transfers between Armenia and countries such as Russia, Greece, Cyprus, Israel, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan; a transfer is received in the app with its code, amount and currency. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://arka.am/en/news/business/ardshinbank_started_making_international_money_transfers_via_ubpay_system/

author: notes-digital
title: Instant transfers from Fora-Bank
body: The bank offers instant mobile transfers from Fora-Bank to Ardshinbank. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/?lang=en

author: notes-digital
title: Internet banking for companies
body: Legal entities use internet banking to manage accounts and send payments online; a user guide is published on the website. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://website-api.ardshinbank.am/files/documents/ENG_ARDSHININVESTBANK%20%20IB-aebe771c-0dc1-4dee-969e-90168105facf.pdf

author: notes-digital
title: Remote banking
body: The bank encourages using remote channels, the app and internet banking, for everyday operations instead of visiting a branch. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Banking for SMEs
body: Small and medium-sized businesses get credit products, payment solutions, POS terminals, international cards and other services in one place. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-your-business/business?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Online SME lending
body: On the bank's SME platform, businesses submit loan applications online and an automated lending service decides; the published limit is up to AMD 20 million or equivalent, for up to 60 months. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-your-business/business?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Accepting card payments
body: Merchants can accept cards through POS terminals, the bank's digiPOS app or a POS function on a cash register; installation and routine maintenance of POS terminals are free. Terminals accept Mastercard, Visa, ArCa, JCB, AMEX and Diners. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-your-business/pos-vpos?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Business transfers
body: Companies can make domestic and international transfers, with published tariffs and conditions, including for non-resident legal entities. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/for-your-business/transfers?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Corporate and project finance
body: For large corporate customers the bank focuses on project financing in strategic industries, especially energy, and on trade finance supporting import and export. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-business
title: Partnerships with development banks
body: Ardshinbank works with international institutions, for example EBRD credit lines for on-lending to SMEs and an ADB trade finance facility signed with Citi. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://www.ebrd.com/home/work-with-us/projects/psd/56462.html

author: notes-business
title: Salary projects
body: Through salary projects, employers pay salaries onto Ardshinbank cards; employees then qualify for better loan terms. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-premium
title: STATUS premium banking
body: STATUS is Ardshinbank's premium package: a personal financial adviser, premium cards, preferential terms and lifestyle privileges for customers with substantial balances or salaries. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://statusplus.ardshinbank.am/?lang=en

author: notes-premium
title: Who qualifies for STATUS
body: As published, STATUS is available to customers meeting a minimum average balance or a minimum monthly salary credited to the account; it is free above a higher balance threshold and has a monthly fee otherwise. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://statusplus.ardshinbank.am/?lang=en

author: notes-premium
title: Private and wealth solutions
body: Beyond retail and commercial banking, Ardshinbank offers private banking, wealth solutions and investment banking services. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/Information/about-us?lang=en

author: notes-premium
title: Property purchases with non-cash payments
body: The bank offers preferential rates for non-cash transactions when buying and selling property. Summarised from Ardshinbank's public website in October 2026; rates, fees and conditions change, so check the bank's current terms. Source: https://ardshinbank.am/?lang=en
